annotations.title: Get all open jobs from company career pages

description: All open jobs from companies in one normalized format (title, company, location with country code, remote/hybrid, seniority, salary, skills, apply URL, posted date). Give career-page URLs (the company's own careers page or its job board) or just company names; 13 job-board systems are supported (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday, SmartRecruiters, Workable, Rippling, BambooHR, Pinpoint, Breezy, Recruitee, Personio, Teamtailor) and found automatically. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/jobs-harvester on your Apify account (about $0.001 per job; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

company_names.description: Company names, e.g. ["Datadog", "Ramp"]; each is looked up on every supported job-board system.

countries.description: Keep jobs in these countries: ISO codes ("US", "DE") or names.

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 50, max 500). Cost scales with this.

posted_within_days.description: Only jobs posted in the last N days.

title_includes.description: Keep jobs whose title contains any of these.

name: get_company_jobs

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.
